title: Lazur in Gmail: write replies by voice and clear your inbox
metaTitle: AI assistant for Gmail on Mac: replies by voice
description: An AI assistant for Gmail on Mac: hold a key to sum up a long email, draft the reply at your cursor, or dictate a new message. No extension to grant inbox access.
intro: Lazur is an AI assistant for Gmail on your Mac: open an email, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask it to sum it up or draft the reply. It reads only what is on your screen, only while you hold the key.
tldr: Open the email and hold ⌥ ⌘. Ask “what do they want?” and Lazur answers out loud.
Say “reply, yes to Tuesday, ask for the invoice” and the draft appears in the reply box.
Hold fn to dictate a new email. Clean text, no “um”s.
Nothing gets access to your whole inbox. Lazur sees the screen only while you hold the key.

demos.spoken: reply, Tuesday at 2 works, and ask them to send the invoice before then
demos.result: Wrote the reply in the Gmail compose box for you to check.
demos.output:
Hi Dana,

Tuesday at 2 works for me. Could you send the invoice before then?

Thanks,
Veer
demos.context: An email asking to move a call

demos.spoken: what's the actual ask in this email?
demos.result: They want a signed copy of the contract by Friday and a yes or no on the extra seat.

asks.result: Tells you the ask, the deadline and who it is from.

asks.say: reply, sounds good, see you Monday
asks.result: Writes a short reply at your cursor.

asks.say: where do I set up a signature?
asks.result: Circles the gear icon, then walks you to Signature.

asks.say: remind me to follow up on this Friday
schedule this to send tomorrow at 8
asks.result: Points at the arrow next to Send and the Schedule send option.
Rewrites your selected draft text at the cursor.

blocks.text: Email is where the typing goes

Most replies are three sentences you already know. Lazur lets you say them. Open the email, hold ⌥ ⌘, and tell Lazur what you want to say. It reads the message on screen and writes a reply that answers it.
How to write a Gmail reply by voice on a Mac

items: Open the email in Gmail and click Reply.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ and say what the reply should say.
Read the draft Lazur writes, change anything, and click Send.

blocks.text: Turn on Gmail keyboard shortcuts in Settings > See all settings > Keyboard shortcuts. Then r replies and e archives. See [our dictation guide](/blog/how-to-write-emails-by-voice) for more.

faq.question: Does Lazur need access to my Gmail account?
faq.answer: No. There is no Gmail sign-in or extension with inbox access. Lazur sees the email on your screen only while you hold the shortcut.

faq.question: Does it work in Apple Mail and Outlook too?
faq.answer: Yes. It works on top of any Mac app, so the same commands work in Apple Mail and Outlook.

faq.question: Will it send emails without me?
faq.answer: No. It writes the draft at your cursor. You send it.
